previous_catalog_record.summary: Grid laid out as a 2×2 grid of ROOMS separated by 1-wide WALLS (color 1) plus an outer wall frame. Each room is a rectangular 3-5 × 3-5 0-bg interior. 1-2 rooms have a SEED cell at their center in color 2 (red). Rule: detect the room-graph (rectangular regions separated by walls). For each room that CONTAINS a color-2 cell, collect its WALL-BOUNDARY CELLS (the wall cells immediately adjacent to that room's interior). Output: a fresh empty grid of the same shape, with those wall cells painted 8 (cyan), everything else 0. Non-seeded rooms' walls stay 0.
skills: room boundaries, wall extraction, boundary rendering

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent set of neighboring room IDs reached from seeded room IDs through color-7 connectors.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Extract non-wall room components, find the room IDs containing color 2, and follow color-7 room-graph edges to their adjacent room IDs.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Collect color-1/color-7 wall-boundary cells of the intermediate target rooms and paint those cells 8 on a blank grid.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The boundary painter consumes exactly the room-ID set produced by graph traversal; replacing it with seeded IDs paints different walls on the same input.
